newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Avonmore says outlook for year good.
newsitem.headline: Avonmore says outlook for year good.

text.p: Avonmore Plc said on Tuesday that the outlook for the full year looked positive and an improved performance in the first half of 1996 reflected better growth in the dairy and meat divisions.

"The board is pleased with the further improvement in performance in the first half of the year and believes a satisfactory result will be achieved for the full year," chairman John Duggan said in a results statement.
